name: Tahngarth, First Mate — that opponent gains control of it until end of combat
notes: Sweep group 6 (2026-10-07). "If you do, choose a player or planeswalker that opponent is attacking. …" was rewritten by the inline-choice step into a "choose one" of two modes ("a player", "planeswalker that opponent is attacking"), which dropped the control effect. A choice of a player is no longer read as modes. The trigger gives Tahngarth to the player picked in the dropdown; "until end of combat" counts as a temporary duration.
